meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.18.17
1) chief eunuch
2) Rab-saris, chief eunuch, a high ranking Babylonian official

elsewhere.note: The king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem.…
All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim, Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, with all…
